name: F&M Co.,Ltd.
summary: F&M Co.,Ltd. provides management support and accounting services for medium and small businesses, and individual business owners. It operates through five segments: Accounting Services Business, Consulting services business, Business Solution Business, Real Estate rental Business and System development business segments. The company offers accounting services for individual business owners and small businesses; and consulting services provides various information services to the general affairs and accounting departments of small and medium-sized enterprises, ISO/P mark/HACCP certification service, and subsidy application support services.
